why: Puts back the exclusion that kept the two branded startup-failure pages out of the sweep. The driver would still apply the WebGL override, so nothing would fail -- the states would simply stop being measured, which is the shape the original defect had. Kills the exclusion-map case, the swept-list case and the empty-set case, and that last one is the point: it is what stops the override guard beside it from passing while guarding a set with nothing in it.
